summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Google Maps Location Scraper with new features: Yellow border/badge for missing descriptions, Instagram scraping from websites, and CSV export with Instagram handle format. All 14 backend tests passed (100%). All frontend features working correctly.
passed_tests: Yellow border (ring-2 ring-yellow-400) appears on cards without description
Yellow 'No Description' badge displays on cards missing description
Cards WITH descriptions do NOT have yellow border/badge
Instagram links display on location cards that have them (17 out of 20 on first page)
Instagram link href format correct (e.g., https://instagram.com/gramercytavern)
CSV export downloads correctly with proper filename
CSV export has Instagram column with just handle (no @ prefix, not full URL) - verified: 'gramercytavern'
CSV export empty Instagram column for places without IG
Search returns results for Foodie category in NYC (38-39 total results)
Export All button shows correct count
Export Selected button appears when items selected
New/Seen badges display correctly on location cards
Remove button removes cards from view (20 -> 19 cards)
History page loads and shows search records with expandable details
Config page loads with System Info and Experience Types tabs
All basic API endpoints working (categories, regions, config)
Search validation working (requires category and location)
onImageError prop passed to LocationCard for broken image handling
seed_data_creation: None needed - using live Google Places API
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features (yellow border for missing descriptions, Instagram scraping from websites, CSV export with IG handle format) are working correctly. The Instagram scraping adds 10-20 seconds to search time due to concurrent website fetching. The History page shows expandable entries with full search details. Config page has tabs for System Info and Experience Types configuration.

instagram_links_on_cards.details: 17 out of 20 cards on first page had Instagram links displayed with correct href format

broken_image_handling.details: onImageError prop is passed to LocationCard component for tracking failed images

pagination.details: Page navigation works, shows Page 1 of 2
